وَخْطٌ [originally an inf. n. (see above)] is said to signify (tropical:) A little, somewhat, or a small degree, of hoariness, or whiteness of the hair. (TA.) ―
-b2- You say also, بَهَا وَخْطٌ مِنْ وَحْشٍ (tropical:) In it [meaning a land (أَرْض)] is a small number of wild animals. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
